title: Halo - Macworld Unveiling
summary: Footage of Bungie's Jason Jones revealing Halo to the public at Macworld on July 21, 1999. It shows the early third-person version of the game.
why: Cited as a historical reference that Halo was first announced at Macworld, with Steve Jobs involved, and nearly launched as a Mac game.

quote.text: You wouldn't think Steve Jobs would personally introduce a game that was multi-platform
